models_evaluated: 3 LLM-based phenotype extraction pipelines (models not named in text)

links.outcome: Change in F1 when moving pipelines from first physician's notes to second physician's notes
links.effect: Without refinement, LLMs dropped 4.4%-5.1% and the rule-based model dropped 8.8% from Phase 1 to Phase 2.
links.quote: However, the LLMs demonstrated better generalizability between physicians without refinement, showing lesser performance decreases (4.4%-5.1%) when transitioning from Phase 1 to Phase 2 without refinement, compared to an 8.8% decrease for the rule-based model.

unlisted_practices: Comparing rule-based NLP with LLM pipelines for clinical entity extraction

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of LLMs versus rule-based NLP for clinical entity and phenotype extraction from clinical notes on an annotated benchmark dataset.
